nodes.label: HAG-59 Report: Orphan Dashboard Nav Links in Sidebar
nodes.rationale: /kitchen-dashboard and /restaurant-dashboard became reachable by adding them as the first Operations item for kitchen and waiter roles, with no other file changed because Sidebar.jsx is the only component that renders nav entries and Header.jsx has no route: items. The head Dashboard entry had to become conditional (roleMenusOwnHome check) because getRoleHome() already points kitchen and waiter users at those dashboard routes, so a second entry would have rendered the same page twice and the longest-prefix activeNavId winner would have kept only the head item highlighted; the same reasoning protected the chef role, whose commented-out duplicate entry shows the idea was tried before. badgeCount was lifted into roleMenuItems and the useMemo dependency became [roleMenuItems, dashboardPath] because the roleMenuMap literal is rebuilt every render and is not a stable dependency.

nodes.label: src/App.jsx (route mounts)
nodes.rationale: Holds the protect() route mounts, including /kitchen-dashboard (App.jsx:274, gated to the kitchen role) and /restaurant-dashboard (App.jsx:277, gated to ROLES.RESTAURANT = admin, manager, waiter, kitchen, staff, receptionist). App.jsx does not route to pages/InventoryPage.jsx, which is why the InventoryFlow.jsx 501-write controls are unreachable from any live screen, and the /inventory/procurement path Navigates to /inventory/purchases (App.jsx:313), making InventoryProcurementPage.jsx a shell-only entry.

nodes.label: src/utils/roleHome.js (getRoleHome role map)
nodes.rationale: Maps roles to home paths (kitchen -> /kitchen-dashboard at roleHome.js:21, waiter -> /restaurant-dashboard at roleHome.js:23, plus manager, reception, housekeeping, chef, accounts, staff dashboards). Because getRoleHome() is the sole route into the two orphan dashboards, before the HAG-59 sidebar change no user who had never typed the path could ever open them - and it also means the sidebar's hard-coded head Dashboard entry duplicated the new nav items for kitchen and waiter, forcing the conditional head-entry fix.

nodes.label: src/components/Sidebar/Sidebar.jsx (role nav entries)
nodes.rationale: The single component that renders nav entries (Header.jsx has no route: items). Now adds 'Kitchen Dashboard' for kitchen and 'Restaurant Dashboard' for waiter as the first Operations entry, reusing the already-imported FaFire/FaUtensils icons, and makes the hard-coded head Dashboard entry conditional on roleMenusOwnHome so a role whose menu already covers its own home path does not render the same page twice or strand the new button unlit under the longest-prefix activeNavId winner.

nodes.label: ROLES.RESTAURANT role list
nodes.rationale: The six-role list ['admin','manager','waiter','kitchen','staff','receptionist'] that gates /restaurant-dashboard via protect(); it contains waiter, so the new sidebar link for the waiter role lands on a page the guard admits. The kitchen-dashboard route still carries its inline ['kitchen'] gate at App.jsx:274 rather than the ROLES.* treatment, a mismatch noted but left alone.
